EN:
Ah yes... here it is.
A most tragic story. 100 years ago there was a general by the name of Terus. He commanded his army with an iron fist, and his desire for power was just as great as his strategic competence! In order to obtain his victories in battle even more effectively, he made a pact with the dark forces. But the evil forces betrayed him! The powers of darkness only wanted to gain control of the souls of the soldiers.
Fortunately Terus was interrupted by Lumen Priests during a crucial magic ritual, thus they were able to prevent all of Ancaria from being infested by an army of Demons. But the ritual was already underway so Terus and the soldiers were cursed. Every 100 years - that's what is written here - the soldiers must rise up out of their graves and bring death and destruction to the living. I must admit, I always thought that it was just a scary story. A story that might be told around a bonfire while holding a lantern to your face. Well I guess I was wrong. Please take these documents to Wylmieni.
PTBR:
Ah, sim... aqui está.
Uma história trágica. Há 100 anos, havia um general de nome Terus. Ele comandava o exército com punho de ferro, e o desejo de poder dele era tão grande quanto a competência estratégica! Para obter as vitórias em batalha ainda mais eficazmente, ele fez um pacto com as forças sombrias. Mas as forças do mal o traíram! Os poderes das trevas só queriam tomar o controle das almas dos soldados.
Por sorte, Terus foi interrompido pelos Sacerdotes de Lumen durante um ritual mágico crucial, e assim conseguiram impedir que toda Ancaria fosse infestada por um exército de Demônios. Mas o ritual já estava em andamento, então Terus e os soldados foram amaldiçoados. A cada 100 anos - é o que está escrito aqui - os soldados devem erguer-se de seus túmulos e trazer morte e destruição aos vivos. Devo admitir, eu sempre achei que fosse só uma história de medo. Uma dessas contadas ao redor da fogueira, com a lanterna iluminando o rosto. Bom, acho que estava errado. Por favor, leve estes documentos a Wylmieni.

Greetings! My name is Mintuck, officer of this outpost. It's usually very quiet out here, far from all the strife and intrigue of the Capital. It's one of the reasons I asked to be stationed here.
Lately, though, I get a lot of strange reports about even stranger events. My scouts reported that badly wounded and even dead garema were found in the area. Some were badly battered.

Garema are a fierce people, but their internal disputes are usually without bloodshed or serious injuries, and they never fought against my troops. It would help me a great deal if I knew how the garema were killed. Would you be willing to look into it? Amradriel, my best scout will accompany you.

As garema são um povo feroz, mas as disputas internas delas normalmente acontecem sem derramamento de sangue nem ferimentos graves, e elas nunca lutaram contra minhas tropas. Ajudar-me-ia muito saber como as garema foram mortas. Você se disporia a investigar? Amradriel, minha melhor batedora, o acompanhará.
